name: Grendel
title: Hrothgar's Terror
summary: Devour the Halls of Asgard as you bring Despair and feast on defeated foes.
lore: Monstrous Grendel terrorized Hrothgar’s hall, devouring countless people before Beowulf tore the arm from his body. Yet Grendel survived, for the world Shattered as he staggered, bleeding, the currents of aether preserving his life. Now equipped with a mystical prosthetic, he wreaks vengeance upon all humanity, slaying and consuming. Who provided his new arm, and why, only Grendel himself might say.
